properties.name: reflow2's site has a demo page (flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2/demo.html) whose first worked example is the FICTIONAL intelligence-driven capstone: the story in two rounds and a drawn reasoning map, made after phase 6
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-19: "I'd like to document this capstone and add it as a demo project (public on flo2.io) … a page … in flo2-connector.github.io/reflow2/demo"; choices "/demo on both", "the trial design as-is", "the story in two rounds" + "a drawn reasoning map", "post phase 6"
properties.statement:
A demos page, site/demo.html, version-checked like the other site pages. Later demos (the cogito, the logic rung) can sit beside the first.
Its first example is the capstone trial (flo2.io 2a26dc6044306d27, FICTIONAL), told in two rounds:
1. ROUND 1: the four fictional reports and their grades, the assessment with its confidence, why each requirement exists (the decision and the reasoning beneath it), and the threat test.
2. ROUND 2: the intelligence update, and what reflow2 itself named as losing its reason to exist (and, after phase 6, the test read stale).
A DRAWN REASONING MAP, generated from the design and not drawn by hand: reports → assessment → decisions → requirements and test, with the update's fall-out marked.
It links to the public design page on flo2.io (1a97fc1f1de4d5d2:req:flo2-io-shows-the-capstone-as-a-public-demo).
WHEN: after phase 6 (Anthony, 2026-10-19: "This is post phase 6 that I'm meaning, not now"). Before the page is written, the capstone is re-run on the release that carries phase 6, so the page shows those fixes working.
Every page and diagram says plainly that the scenario is FICTIONAL.
